summary: Elevate your team's skills with our Customer Service Excellence training course. Learn best practices to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty today!
lede: Customer service excellence helps service and contact-centre professionals measure service quality, find customer friction, and improve complaint handling across channels. The training covers satisfaction scorecards, SERVQUAL interaction assessment, journey mapping, and complaint workflows guided by ISO 10002:2018 and ISO 10004:2018. Participants use service data to prioritize improvements and communicate a practical roadmap, including spreadsheet analysis and a Power BI dashboard template.
audienceIntro: This customer service excellence course is designed for operational and strategic service professionals who need to improve customer interactions, complaint outcomes, and measurable service quality.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in customer service, customer experience, contact centre operations, complaint handling, service quality, or CRM-supported workflows. Familiarity with basic service measures and spreadsheet use will help you complete the customer service excellence exercises. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted feedback classification, automation governance, and dashboard design are taught at operational application level rather than technical engineering level.
